C arc005.no-ddd-dirs OL ARC-005,ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; ValueObjects/, DomainServices/, Events/ or Exceptions/ appear only when an approved design needs them; business rules alone do not justify DDD-oriented directories. ;; = ;; Approved design. ;;
C x.bl-folder-layout EX ARC-027,DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Scaffold backend folders by role: Application Abstractions/Persistence, Abstractions/ExternalServices, Services, DTOs, Validation, DependencyInjection.cs; Infrastructure Persistence/{Configurations,Repositories,Migrations,Seeding}, Services, DependencyInjection.cs. ;; = ;; Folders only when needed. ;; Directory naming/layout is scaffolding technique outside the oracle (EXC-004).
C arc027.create-when-needed OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Create Abstractions/ExternalServices only when such dependencies exist. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc009.no-handler-structures OL ARC-009 MUST_NOT ;; No handler/CQRS/MediatR structures in Application Services. ;; = ;; Explicit approval. ;;
C arc027.no-dumping-ground OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; DTOs folder holds Application models when useful, not a generic dumping ground. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.app-di-no-infra OL ARC-023,ARC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Application DependencyInjection.cs registers Application-owned services/validation and never concrete Infrastructure implementations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bl-type-role-naming EX RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Make supporting-type roles clear by name/directory using suffixes (Service, Dto, Request/Response, Result/Outcome, Validator, Rules/Policy, Factory, Mapper, Adapter); avoid ambiguous names; add responsibility subdirectories only when a flat directory becomes hard to navigate. ;; = ;; none ;; Type-role naming heuristics explicitly outside the oracle (EXC-004).
C arc027.no-generic-buckets OL ARC-027 AVOID ;; Avoid generic Models, Helpers, Common or Utils buckets when a specific responsibility can be named. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc015.generic-base-infra OL ARC-015 ALLOWED ;; An Infrastructure-only generic repository base is allowed when it removes real duplication. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc023.infra-registers OL ARC-023 DEFAULT ;; Infrastructure DependencyInjection.cs registers AppDbContext, repositories, IUnitOfWork, external adapters, the SQL Server provider, HttpClient integrations and resilience handlers when used. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc029.contracts-when-used OL ARC-029 DEFAULT ;; Api Contracts hold transport-specific request/response contracts, when used. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.middleware-only-when-exists OL ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Create a Middleware folder only when custom middleware actually exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bl-program-extensions EX ARC-012 MUST_NOT ;; Keep Api Extensions cohesive; do not move arbitrary code out of Program.cs solely to make it shorter. ;; = ;; none ;; Program.cs organisation rule not in the oracle.
C arc012.program-root OL ARC-012 DEFAULT ;; Program.cs is the composition root (AddApplication, AddInfrastructure). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep026.localdb-default OL DEP-026 DEFAULT ;; API configuration includes appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json; a Windows Development default is a SQL Server LocalDB connection without secret credentials. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep026.credentials-user-secrets OL DEP-026,SEC-002 MUST ;; Adapt the database name; when local SQL Server requires credentials keep the non-secret structure in configuration and supply the secret through user-secrets. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api017.dev-swagger OL API-017,DEP-012 DEFAULT ;; Configure Swagger generation and UI so a Development run exposes /swagger. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.check-refs OL WF-007,ARC-001 MUST ;; After adding project references run node .claude/scripts/check-manifests.mjs from the repository root to check the reference graph. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bl-cli-refs EX - DEFAULT ;; Add project references with the dotnet CLI (dotnet add ... reference ...). ;; = ;; none ;; Tooling technique not in the oracle.
